issue.description:
Plan sections: "State & reliability" and "Testing & validation" (AS-3/AS-4) in docs/plan/plan.md.

hasTranscriptAdvanced() in daemon/reconcile.ts assumes transcript entries carry a numeric epoch-ms timestamp and types like user_message or a top-level role field. Real Claude Code transcript JSONL entries carry ISO-8601 string timestamps (e.g. 2026-06-20T12:52:29.993Z), top-level type of user/assistant with role nested under message.role, plus non-message lines (file-history-snapshot, mode, progress).

Consequence: the guard (entryTime <= lastStuckAt) compares an ISO string to a number, which is NaN-false, so the time filter never skips pre-stuck entries; the assistant entry that just produced the Stop matches (entry.type === "assistant") and the function returns true. Every real stuck session is therefore dequeued on the next reconcile tick (5s). The synthetic fixtures in test-walking-skeleton.sh use numeric timestamps, which is why AS-3/AS-4 pass while real usage is broken.

Fix:
- Parse timestamps robustly: Date.parse for ISO strings, pass through numbers.
- Only treat entries strictly newer than last_stuck_at as progress.
- Recognize the real entry shape (type user/assistant, message.role) and ignore snapshot/mode/progress lines.
- Update fixtures to the real transcript format (preferred) while keeping tests deterministic.
- Cleanup: daemon/reconcile.ts imports TranscriptEntry from daemon/types.ts (not exported there) and re-declares a local interface of the same name; remove the bogus import and keep one definition.

Acceptance criteria:
- New fixture test using real-format JSONL (ISO timestamps, nested message) shows: (a) a session stays queued while the transcript tail is only its pre-stuck assistant message; (b) appending a real-format user entry timestamped after the stuck time dequeues it within one sweep.
- test-walking-skeleton.sh AS-1..AS-7 still pass.
issue.title: Reconcile loop misparses real Claude Code transcripts - stuck sessions falsely dequeued within one 5s sweep

issue.close_reason: Fixed trailboss-bootstrap to check panes are actually stuck before flagging. Added hash_output(), looks_like_prompt(), and is_pane_stuck() helpers that mirror the quiet-threshold logic from tmux-detector.ts. Now only injects synthetic Stop events for Claude panes that are truly idle (unchanged output for 30s + prompt-like).
issue.description:
bin/trailboss-bootstrap injects a synthetic Stop event for every tmux pane whose
pane_current_command == "claude" that isn't already in the daemon's queue — with no
check for whether that pane is actually idle/waiting vs. actively mid-turn. It runs
automatically on every bin/trailboss-start.

daemon/tmux-detector.ts already implements the right check elsewhere in this same
repo: a quiet-threshold (TRAILBOSS_QUIET_THRESHOLD_MS, default 30s) plus
capture-pane output-hash comparison to decide a pane is actually stuck, not just
running claude. trailboss-bootstrap should reuse that same
quiescence/output-hash logic (or shell out to the detector's single-pane check)
before injecting a synthetic Stop, instead of treating "command == claude" as
sufficient.

Concrete failure scenario: operator has N active Claude Code sessions genuinely
mid-turn (e.g. the 13 NATO-named tmux sessions alpha..mike observed live on
2026-07-20) and runs trailboss-start (e.g. after the systemd migration in ADR-1,
or just a fresh dashboard attach) — bootstrap would queue all N as "stuck", none of
which the operator actually needs to act on, defeating the FIFO signal-to-noise the
whole tool exists to provide.

Files: bin/trailboss-bootstrap, daemon/tmux-detector.ts (reference implementation
of the quiet-threshold check to reuse)
issue.title: trailboss-bootstrap flags any running claude pane as stuck, not just idle ones

- daemon/tmux-adapter.ts   -> wired via bin/trailboss-tmux-watch (POSTs to /event/normalized). Not mentioned in README or docs/plan/plan.md.

issue.description:

endpoint) cannot tell "all caught up" from "the whole tool is dead" by looking at

visible signal).

(e.g. "✗ down") vs stuck-count (e.g. "⚠ 3") vs healthy-empty (blank or "✓"). Same

apply the equivalent fix to the bash status-line segment which currently does not).

independent of ADR-1 and should ship regardless — a reliable dead-daemon indicator

issue.description:
Trail Boss is entirely pull-based today: the status-line segment and TUI both
require the operator to be attached to a tmux client to see anything. If the
operator is away from the terminal entirely (not attached to any tmux client —
e.g. commuting, sleeping), stuck sessions pile up silently with zero notification
until they next attach. This is the same "human on the loop, not in it" gap the
tool otherwise solves for in-session switching, just not solved yet for the
case of "not in any session."

telegram-claude-bridge.service already runs on this host as a systemd --user
service with a working outbound notification channel — reuse that integration
(or a similar one) to fire a message when the queue's stuck count crosses a
configurable threshold (e.g. >=1, or after N minutes at the head unresolved) and
has not already sent one for the current head item, so it doesn't spam per-event.
Rate-limit / dedupe so a burst of Stop events doesn't produce a burst of messages.

Files: daemon/index.ts or a new daemon/notify.ts, integration point with
telegram-claude-bridge (check ~/telegram-claude-bridge for its send-message
interface/API)

Plan sections: "State & reliability", "Failure modes & invariants", and Phase 3 exit criterion ("state survives a daemon restart - rebuilt from transcripts") in docs/plan/plan.md. AS-4 requires: collector down when a Stop fires (POST lost); on restart, the reconcile sweep rebuilds the queue from transcripts and the session appears.

Current state: daemon/reconcile.ts only DEQUEUES (transcript advanced -> drop). It never ENQUEUES a session whose transcript shows it stopped while the daemon was down. test-walking-skeleton.sh documents this openly in its AS-4 section: "the daemon has no startup transcript scan ... POST-lost-before-registration not recoverable" - the test only validates the achievable subset (SQLite persistence).

Implement:
- During each sweep (or at minimum at daemon startup), for every session in the sessions table NOT currently queued, inspect the transcript tail; if the newest entry is a completed assistant turn with no later user entry, enqueue as reason=stopped with stuck_at derived from that entry timestamp.
- Do not enqueue sessions whose pane no longer exists (verify via tmux list-panes, or retire the session row).
- Depends on the real-format transcript parsing fix (see the reconcile misparse bug bead) - build on the corrected parser.

Acceptance criteria:

- OPTIONS preflight is no longer honored (expect 404 or non-204).

Acceptance criteria:

issue.description:
.claude/trailboss-emit.sh POSTs each hook payload once and always exits 0 (hooks
must not block/fail the CLI), so any POST that lands while the daemon is
restarting (e.g. during the systemd auto-restart window from ADR-1, RestartSec
plus daemon boot time) is silently and permanently dropped for that event. The
reconcile loop backstops *stuck* detection on restart by re-scanning transcripts,
but a dropped UserPromptSubmit (dequeue signal) has no equivalent backstop within
the same restart window — worst case a resolved session stays queued until the
next reconcile sweep notices the transcript advanced.

Add a small bounded local retry/spool in trailboss-emit.sh: on POST failure, retry
once or twice with a short backoff (still must stay fast enough not to block the
hook noticeably), or append the failed payload to a small local queue file that a
daemon-side "replay on startup" step consumes. Keep it bounded (e.g. last N
failed events, drop oldest) so a long outage doesn't grow it unbounded — the
reconcile loop is still the authoritative backstop for the stuck-detection side
per docs/plan/plan.md's "State & reliability" section.

References: ADR-1 in docs/plan/plan.md (this bead is the client-side hardening
follow-on named in that ADR's Consequences section).

Files: .claude/trailboss-emit.sh, daemon/index.ts, daemon/reconcile.ts
issue.title: Bound client-side retry for dropped hook POSTs during daemon restart window
